imagePrompts.thumbnail: Use case: stylized-concept. Create a premium Korean website editorial thumbnail, landscape 16:9, 1600x900 composition. Bright flat cyan background, warm ivory and black, restrained vermilion accent. Tactile screenprinted editorial cut-paper collage rather than shiny 3D. Left 60 percent contains exact Korean headline in three consistently sized lines: '홈페이지가 느릴 때' / '이미지만 줄이면' / '해결될까요?' Heavy clean Korean sans, glyph height around 110px on a 1600 canvas, generous line spacing, safe margins 80px. Discreet lowercase 'nuvio' top left. Right side: a small photographic image tile, metal movable-type letter block, and a restrained cable/gear assembly arranged as separated ingredients of a website, visually communicating that images are only one part. No dashboard, no stopwatch, no speed score or percentage. Avoid giant poster type, gradients, navy, tiny labels. Exact spelling required. This is an article illustration, not a real website screenshot.
imagePrompts.body: Use case: photorealistic-natural. Landscape 16:9 editorial photograph, 1600x900 framing. An ordinary Korean business website manager seated by a window, over-the-shoulder close view focusing on their hands holding a smartphone beside an open laptop, checking the same understated corporate product website across mobile and desktop. Phone held naturally, realistic hands and device proportions. Screen layouts show ivory backgrounds, restrained burgundy accents, product photo tiles and simple menu, no readable text, no browser scores, no metrics, no logos. The smartphone is a vertically reflowed version of the laptop content, not a shrunken desktop screen. Warm natural daylight, genuine everyday workspace, modest materials, no luxury staged office, no extra people, no robots, no holographic UI. Subject communicates checking readability and menu use across devices. Person is fictional illustrative, not a real employee or client. Composition keeps devices clear and usable within crop, premium documentary magazine photography with believable small details.
